## Status: Null Baseline (Degenerate)

- Zero exposure across all folds
- No strategy file loaded

This is an empty baseline awaiting initial strategy.

```
aub discover --lane ost_v62_unified --mode bootstrap --n_candidates 50
aub status --lane ost_v62_unified
aub promote --lane ost_v62_unified --if-better
```

**Rationale**: Starting from null baseline requires discovery phase to generate candidate strategies. Bootstrap mode will create initial population, status monitors progress, promote will crown first non-degenerate champion.
